title: Sequent-style tableaux for first-order logic: structural analysis, cut admissibility, and the correspondence with LK
summary: We give a self-contained development of the first-order block calculus in unsigned sequent-style notation: each node of the refutation tree carries a finite block $Π= Γ\cup \neg[Δ]$, negation is governed by explicit rules, and a branch closes on a complementary pair of literals. The calculus is Smullyan's, and so in substance are the theorems; what is offered here is a different arrangement of them.
